evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm at growth onset, following low post-purge readings.
Oxygen increased progressively to 17.1 ppm during growth.
Oxygen has risen steadily to 33.2 ppm despite maintained argon flow, indicating loss of the established low-oxygen condition.
Temperature 750.5 °C matches the 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 45.4%, argon flow 99.2 sccm matches 100 sccm, and pressure remains 760.1 Torr.

args.missing_evidence: An independent oxygen check and leak/inlet-gas purity tests are needed to distinguish air ingress, gas contamination, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
